_comment: Each entry below was verified live (hit the actual Greenhouse/Lever/Workday API) before being added, and had at least one real MuleSoft-related posting at verification time. Big Indian IT-services firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini) and boutique MuleSoft partners (Apisero, Closeloop, Twistellar, Prowess Software) don't run any of these three platforms - guessed/searched slugs all 404'd, they use a custom portal instead. This is NOT exhaustive - it's what surfaced across several search passes, each individually verified. Add more the same way: find a real job URL on the company's careers page, confirm the platform from the URL shape, verify it resolves before trusting it.
